verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents percentage rollouts and gradual rollout rules that can be ramped, scheduled, or automatically increased through a release plan. Its SDKs use deterministic hashing so the same attributes always get the same assignment. Rule changes are served through the SDK payload and real-time streaming rather than code changes, so no redeploy is needed. Missing for 10: explicit docs that rollout rules (not just experiments) bucket by a hash attribute, explicit 1%-granularity ramp detail, automated ramp schedules being gated to a higher pricing tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a percentage ramp.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying
